# 📊 Dynatrace License consumption
**Davis Data Units (DDU)** and **Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM)** consumption for the selected timeframe, broken down by pool,
entity type, host, metric, application and synthetic monitor.

* Template for **classic-licensed** environments (DDU + DEM). In a Dynatrace Platform Subscription (DPS) environment such as rha75589 the
  `builtin:billing.*` metrics carry no data, so the tiles stay empty here.
* Every tile reads the classic **Metrics API v2** (`builtin:billing.*`) through a code tile, so it works without Grail.
  Viewers need permission to read metrics (`environment-api:metrics:read`).
* DDU values are reported by Dynatrace. **DEM values are estimates**: session, action and request counts × the classic DEM weights
  (set in `DEM_WEIGHTS` in each DEM tile). For billed figures, see **Account Management → License / Subscription**.
* Billing metrics lag by about 1–2 h. Use a timeframe of at least 24 h; the default is the last 30 days.

2.title: Total DDU consumed
2.description: Sum of all DDU pools (metrics, logs, events, traces, serverless) in the timeframe.

3.title: Metric DDU
3.description: DDU consumed by custom, extension, calculated and ingested metrics beyond the included per-host data points.

4.title: Estimated DEM units
4.description: Real User Monitoring sessions and synthetic executions converted to DEM units with DEM_WEIGHTS.

5.title: Session Replay share of web sessions
5.description: Share of billed web sessions captured with Session Replay. These cost 4× a plain session (1.0 vs 0.25 DEM).

6.title: DDU by pool
6.description: Share of DDU consumption per DDU pool.

7.title: Estimated DEM by capability
7.description: Share of estimated DEM per RUM / synthetic capability.

8.title: DEM capability detail
8.description: Billed sessions, user action properties, actions, requests and results, and the DEM they convert to.

10.title: Daily DDU by pool
10.description: DDU per day and pool. Look for step changes after new extensions, log sources or custom metrics.

11.title: Daily estimated DEM (RUM vs Synthetic)
11.description: Estimated DEM per day split into RUM sessions/properties, Session Replay sessions and synthetic executions.

24.content: ## ✅ Porting check — billing metrics available in this environment

25.title: Billing metric availability
25.description: Checks each billing metric this dashboard uses. After importing into another environment, every row should be OK; 'No data' on a DEM row is expected if that capability (e.g. mobile, Session Replay) is not used.

26.content:
**Classic DEM weights used for estimates** — web/mobile/custom session **0.25** · session with Session Replay **1.0** ·
user action property **0.01** · browser monitor action **1.0** · HTTP monitor request **0.1** · third-party result **0.1**.
Adjust `DEM_WEIGHTS` in the tiles if your contract differs. Source: `dashboards/dynatrace-license-consumption/` in the Isatec-RHA-SaaS repo.
